class.name: TdJsonManager
class.brief_description: Manages the TDLib JSON client and its polling thread.
class.description:
Provides synchronous TDLib requests, logging configuration, TDLib initialization, and a background polling thread. Use [code]create_client[/code] to create a [code]TdJsonClient[/code] for sending requests and receiving responses. General pattern of usage: [codeblocks] [gdscript] var client := TdJsonManager.create_client() # or var client := TdJsonClient.create()
client.request_received.connect(_on_request_received) client.start_poll() func _on_request_received(response): # parse the response as a JSON object and process it as an incoming update or the answer to a previously sent request pass [/gdscript]

method.name: create_client
method.description: Creates a TDLib client instance and returns it.

method.name: execute
method.description: Synchronously executes a TDLib request. A request can be executed synchronously only if it is documented with "Can be called synchronously".

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns true if the poll is running.

method.name: receive
method.description: Receives incoming updates and request responses. Must not be called simultaneously from two different threads.

method.name: remove_client
method.description: Removes and destroys a TDLib client created by [code]create_client[/code] or [code]TdJsonClient.create()[/code].

method.name: set_log_callback
method.description: Sets the callback called when a message is added to the internal TDLib log. The callback must accept [code]verbosity_level[/code] and [code]message[/code].

method.name: set_max_verbosity_level
method.description: Sets the max verbosity level for log callbacks: - Level 0 = fatal errors - Level 1 = errors - Level 2 = warnings and debug warnings - Level 3 = informational - Level 4 = debug - Level 5 = verbose debug - Level 6+ = even more detailed logging (your own verbosity)

method.name: set_tdlib_parameters
method.description: Sets the parameters for TDLib initialization. Activates on [code]authorizationStateWaitTdlibParameters[/code]. - [code]api_id[/code] - Application identifier for Telegram API access, which can be obtained at [url=https://my.telegram.org]https://my.telegram.org[/url]. - [code]api_hash[/code] - Application identifier hash for Telegram API access, which can be obtained at [url=https://my.telegram.org]https://my.telegram.org[/url]. - [code]application_version[/code] - Application version; must be non-empty. - [code]device_model[/code] - Model of the device the application is being run on; must be non-empty. - [code]database_directory[/code] - Path to the directory for the persistent database; by default uses user data directory ([code]"user://tdlib_data/"[/code]). - [code]use_test_dc[/code] - If true, the Telegram test environment will be used instead of the production environment. - [code]files_directory[/code] - Path to the directory for storing files; by default uses [code]database_directory[/code]. - [code]use_file_database[/code] - If true, information about downloaded and uploaded files will be saved between application restarts. - [code]use_message_database[/code] - If true, the local database will be used for storing chats and messages between application restarts. - [code]use_secret_chats[/code] - If true, support for secret chats will be enabled. - [code]system_language_code[/code] - IETF language tag of the user's operating system language; By default uses locale language of the OS. - [code]system_version[/code] - Version of the user's operating system; By default uses the version of the OS.

method.name: set_verbosity_level
method.description: Sets the verbosity level for Tdlib logs. Can be also used as: [codeblocks] [gdscript] { "@type": "setLogVerbosityLevel", "new_verbosity_level": new_verbosity_level } [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]
